settings.title: VM providers

form.name: Name
form.tokenSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored secret
form.caHint: The cluster's own CA (/etc/pve/pve-root-ca.pem). Leave empty for a certificate from a public CA.
form.backup: Back up before sleep to storage
form.enrollUrl: Address new machines reach pdmux at
form.defaultsSummary: {cores} vCPU · {memory} GB memory · {disk} GB disk · ids {min}–{max}
form.poolAuto: Automatic — pdmux if the cluster has it
form.required: pdmux uses this platform's API to create machines from a template and to start, sleep, restart and delete them. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.fullCloneTip: Off: a linked clone that shares the template's disk — created in seconds and small. On: an independent full copy — slower, but the template can then be changed or removed, and it is required on storage that cannot link (plain LVM, for example).
form.nodeTip: The node new machines are created on. Empty: the template's node.
form.storageTip: Where a full copy puts its disk. Empty: the template's storage. A linked clone always stays beside its template.
form.poolTip: The Proxmox pool new machines go in — the token's rights are usually granted on a pool. Empty: pdmux, when the cluster has a pool by that name.
form.sleepTagTip: Only machines carrying this tag can be put to sleep. A sleeping machine makes its scheduled backup fail, so tag the machines you took out of the backup schedule; machines pdmux creates get the tag. Empty: every machine can sleep.
form.backupTip: Before putting a machine to sleep, back it up to this storage when its newest backup is older than a day. Empty: no backup.
form.enrollUrlTip: The address a new machine uses to reach this pdmux server. Empty: this server's own address. Set it when machines reach pdmux by another name than browsers do. Plain http is fine on a private network.
form.templateTip: The template new machines are cloned from. Empty: the one tagged pdmux-template — none, or several, is asked rather than guessed.
form.vmidRangeTip: Ids pdmux may give new machines. An id used by another machine, or remembered by a backup, is skipped.
form.diskTip: The boot disk is grown to this before the first boot. A template disk that is already larger is left as it is.

mcpUserTokens.hint: Turning this off stops existing tokens from working without deleting them. Turning it on restores them.

sweep.offNote: 0 — no host is ever deleted automatically. This is the shipped default.
sweep.onNote: On. Hosts silent for longer than the window are deleted on the next sweep, and the list warns for the last seven days before that.
sweep.neverSwept: A host that has never connected is never swept: a row with no last-seen is a machine whose installer has not run yet.
sweep.armWarning: Every host silent for longer than the window is DELETED on the next sweep, with its agent tokens, enrollment codes, services and collected history. Each of those machines is then refused until somebody registers it again and re-runs the installer. This cannot be undone.
sweep.atRisk: {count} hosts are already past {days} days and would go on the next sweep:
